name: mcp-swedish-weather
description: Provides access to current weather conditions and hourly forecasts for any location in Sweden using the SMHI Open Data API. It supports built-in city lists, coordinate inputs, and geocoding fallback to deliver detailed meteorological data without requiring authentication.
